title: The Reading Corner
roomStory: A corner built for slowing down. Warm textures, soft light, and a deliberate arrangement of things that invite you to stay a little longer. Everything here was chosen to feel good before it was chosen to look good.

title: The Still Kitchen
roomStory: A kitchen that earns its quiet. Linen, ceramic, and aged wood — objects that age beautifully and improve with use. Nothing performative, everything purposeful.

title: The Morning Bedroom
roomStory: Designed around the first hour of the day. Soft light, breathable layers, and a single stem in a bud vase. A room that feels like a deep exhale.
